findingClass: a required document type (DRHP/RHP/PROSPECTUS) on a live-window IPO is stuck in extraction (MANUAL_REVIEW, EXTRACT_FAILED, or FAILED behind a HARD_FAILURE marker) with nothing FAIL-level watching it
failThreshold: any UPCOMING/OPEN/CLOSED/LISTED IPO's DRHP/RHP/PROSPECTUS document has extraction_status=MANUAL_REVIEW, a sibling document_fetch_state.state=EXTRACT_FAILED, or extraction_status=FAILED with an extraction_error starting HARD_FAILURE:, for more than 48h
unverifiableWhen: never - always runs against documents/document_fetch_state joined to ipos
